major_cooldowns.name: Deathmark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown as your primary burst cooldown; always apply Improved Garrote via Vanish immediately before pressing it, and stack all trinkets and racials into this window.

major_cooldowns.name: Kingsbane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown every 60 seconds; when both Kingsbane and Deathmark are available simultaneously, press Deathmark first then Kingsbane immediately after to exploit doubled poison applications - never hold Kingsbane as it risks desynchronizing the next Deathmark pairing.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: In single target, treat Vanish as an extension of Deathmark - use it just before Deathmark to apply Improved Garrote into the burst window; in Mythic+, hold it for chain-pulls where you cannot stealth beforehand.

rules.action: Always cast Vanish followed immediately by Garrote before pressing Deathmark so that the Improved Garrote empowered bleed is active and doubled for the full burst window.

When both Deathmark and Kingsbane are available at the same time, always cast Deathmark first then Kingsbane right after - the doubled poison applications from Deathmark cause Kingsbane to ramp to maximum stacks significantly faster.

rules.description: Never hold Kingsbane - press on cooldown
rules.action: Press Kingsbane as soon as it comes off cooldown; any delay pushes back your next Deathmark sync at the 2-minute mark and loses stacking DoT damage during the window you created.
Use Deathmark on cooldown every 2 minutes; it is your primary burst amplifier and all other buffs orbit around it - holding it for a perfect scenario costs more than it gains.

rules.description: Double Garrote in the opener for Improved Garrote extension
rules.action: Start in stealth, cast Garrote, build to 5+ combo points with Mutilate, cast Rupture, then immediately cast Garrote a second time to extend the Improved Garrote stealth amplifier before you enter your cooldown sequence - you have a 6-second window to land the second Garrote.

rules.description: Dump combo points with Envenom before cooldowns
rules.action: Cast Envenom to spend all combo points before pressing Deathmark and Kingsbane so you enter the burst window with a fresh combo point bar and can immediately build back into finishers.

rules.description: Apply weapon poisons before every fight
rules.action: Apply Deadly Poison and Amplifying Poison (if talented) to your weapons before combat begins - these poisons are the engine that drives Kingsbane's ramp and Deathmark's doubled application effect.
Keep Rupture active on your target at all times by refreshing it at 5+ combo points before it expires; losing Rupture costs significant energy regeneration on top of its direct damage.

rules.description: Maintain Garrote and apply from stealth whenever possible
rules.action: Keep Garrote up on your main target at all times and always apply it from stealth (opener or Vanish) to get the Improved Garrote damage amplification - the stealth-empowered version is doubled again by Deathmark.

rules.description: Drop Envenom buff at 80 Implacable stacks for energy burst
rules.action: Once Implacable reaches 80 stacks (after 5 consecutive Envenoms), intentionally let the Envenom buff expire to collect the 80% energy regeneration burst - skip this only when you are in Bloodlust or heavy AoE where dropping the buff would cause you to overcap energy.

rules.description: Rupture over Envenom when both are due
rules.action: If Rupture is about to expire and you have 5+ combo points, always cast Rupture before Envenom - if you ever find yourself choosing between a Darkest Night Envenom and Rupture, you made a mistake earlier and should have used Rupture on the previous finisher.

rules.description: Time Envenoms toward end of buff duration
rules.action: Cast each new Envenom near the end of your current Envenom buff's duration rather than immediately after it expires - this maximizes Envenom uptime and gives more time for energy to regenerate between casts.

rules.description: Crimson Tempest to spread bleeds in AoE
rules.action: In AoE use Crimson Tempest at 5+ combo points to spread your highest-duration bleeds to nearby targets; once all targets have bleeds, switch to Fan of Knives for combo point generation and Envenom to spend them.

rules.description: Fan of Knives is your AoE builder at 2+ targets
rules.action: On 2 or more targets swap from Mutilate to Fan of Knives as your primary combo point builder - unless you have the Blindside talent (used in raid builds), which makes Mutilate worth using on up to 2 targets.

rules.description: Shiv for the last combo point with Deathstalker build
rules.action: When playing Deathstalker with Toxic Stiletto and you are 1 combo point away from maximum while Darkest Night is active, cast Shiv instead of Mutilate - it costs only 10 energy versus Mutilate's higher cost and avoids wasting combo points from an overshoot.

source_summary: Assassination Rogue in Midnight rotates around a 2-minute Deathmark burst window: use Vanish to apply Improved Garrote, then immediately stack Deathmark and Kingsbane to double poison applications and ramp Kingsbane's DoT to maximum stacks. Kingsbane is pressed on cooldown every 60 seconds and never held, as any delay risks desynchronizing from the Deathmark window at the 2-minute mark. Between burst windows the rotation is a deliberate build-and-spend cycle maintaining Rupture and Garrote bleeds as the top priority, with the Implacable apex talent rewarding players who intentionally let Envenom expire at 80 stacks to collect a burst of energy regeneration - skipped only during Bloodlust or heavy AoE where doing so would cause energy overcapping.
